characters.name: Darrow
characters.description: A former Red Helldiver modified into a Gold to infiltrate the ruling class. He is struggling with the emotional weight of his mission and the terrifying reality of his enemies' power.
key_events: Learned the Aureate form dances with supernatural skill
Convinced Matteo of his identity as a Red
Attempted to ride a horse and was mocked by a Gold girl

characters.name: Matteo
characters.description: An operative of the Sons of Ares tasked with training Darrow in Gold customs and behavior. He is deeply suspicious of Darrow's origins and harbors intense fear regarding the consequences of failure.
key_events: Trained Darrow in Aureate dance forms
Confronted Darrow about his true nature and origins
Took Darrow for a riding lesson at the stables of Ishtar

characters.name: Dancer
characters.description: A high-level member of the Sons of Ares who manages the logistical aspects of Darrow's transformation and cover story. He is pragmatic and focused on the technical requirements of the infiltration.
key_events: Informed Darrow that the Board of Quality Control officially changed his name to Darrow au Andromedus

characters.name: Unnamed Gold Girl
characters.description: A young Gold woman seen at the stables who demonstrates superior riding skills and mocks Darrow's ineptitude.
key_events: Mocked Darrow's inability to ride his pony effectively

relationships.description: A tense professional relationship defined by mistrust; Matteo doubts Darrow's background, while Darrow fears being exposed.
moments: Matteo aggressively interrogates Darrow regarding his past in the mines.

relationships.description: A collaborative relationship focused on the success of Darrow's infiltration mission.
moments: Dancer updates Darrow on the successful hacking of his legal identity.

world_facts.name: Aureate Dances
world_facts.description: Formalized Gold social and martial movements, including the Polemides (child of war), which mimics the motions of sword fighting.

world_facts.name: Sons of Ares
world_facts.description: A revolutionary group seeking to overthrow the Society by infiltrating and dismantling the Gold power structure.

world_facts.name: Board of Quality Control
world_facts.description: The administrative body responsible for the records and identity of individuals within the Society, currently compromised by the Sons of Ares.

summary: Darrow continues his rigorous training under Matteo, mastering the Aureate dances with ease due to his innate physical enhancements and background in the mines. His performance of the Polemides, a martial dance, triggers suspicion in Matteo, who expresses deep fear regarding the consequences of failure—specifically the torture and execution of their allies and Darrow's family. Darrow asserts his identity, but the exchange leaves him shaken by the sheer power and brutality of the Golds, whom he now realizes he must destroy. Later, Dancer confirms that hackers have successfully altered Darrow's legal identity to 'Darrow au Andromedus,' a move Darrow treats with detached fatalism. The chapter concludes with a visit to the stables of Ishtar, where Darrow attempts to learn to ride horses. His ineptitude attracts the mockery of a young Gold girl, highlighting the social gap he must bridge to succeed in his infiltration.
